summary: First-run e2e testing of Kid English Trainer. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests pass for /api/content, /api/topics, /api/topics/{id} (valid + 404). Frontend: full navigation (menu -> levels for numbers -> tasks -> game -> complete -> back) works. All 4 task types verified end-to-end on real UI: Recognize (10 correct picks -> RoundComplete, 10 stars), Match (colors, 2 batches of 4, 8 stars, RoundComplete), Speak (headless mic path via next-word-button through 10 items -> RoundComplete, no correct/incorrect judgment shown), Write (typed uppercase target from emoji aria-label for 10 foods, tiles turn green, hint button works, next-word-button advances, 10 stars, RoundComplete). Star counter persists and reset-progress-button zeroes it. Mute toggle works. Back button disabled on menu screen. All required data-testid attributes present.
critical_code_review_comments: SpeakTask awards a star only after stopRecording() finishes; in headless environments (no mic) users advance via next-word-button and earn 0 stars for the round. That is acceptable per spec (no scoring) but means RoundComplete always shows 1 star for the speak round in headless. Consider whether that is desired for real devices without mic.
MatchTask completes after only 2 batches of 4 (8 items) regardless of pool size (e.g. 25 animals). If longer sessions are desired, expose BATCH count as content-driven.
TopicMenu star-counter is duplicated in header (star-rewards-counter) and body (0 tähteä pill). Minor: consider consolidating.
Backend seed_content runs on startup AND is re-triggered inside GET /api/content when empty; safe (idempotent upsert) but redundant.
seed_data_creation: Content topics auto-seeded by backend startup event (idempotent upsert).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints stable at /api/content, /api/topics, /api/topics/{id}. For write-task automation, read target from `span[role="img"][aria-label]` on the current game screen and type uppercase to verify case-insensitive completion. For recognize task, click each of 4 options; only the correct one shows 'Hienoa!' and advances after ~950ms. For match, iterate match-word/match-image testids in the current batch. For speak, use next-word-button to advance without mic. All main testids: topic-{id}, task-{id}, number-level-{id}, recognize-option-{en with spaces->hyphens}, match-word-{en}, match-image-{en}, letter-input, write-letter-tiles, hint-button, record-button, next-word-button, back-button, mute-toggle, star-rewards-counter, streak-counter, reset-progress-button, play-again-button.
